newsitem.title: USA: MagneTek to buy back debt issue.
newsitem.headline: MagneTek to buy back debt issue.

text.p: MagneTek Inc, a manufacturer of integrated electrical products, said on Thursday that it is offering to repurchase all of its outstanding 10-3/4 percent senior subordinated debentures due 1998.
The company said it is also seeking consents from the registered holders to amend the indenture to remove restrictive covenants.
The company said it will pay 50 basis points over the 5.5 percent Treasury note due in November 1998, less a $15 consent fee.
The $15 equals the payment for consents to proposed amendments to the indenture.
The company said the tender offer commences today and will expire June 26, unless extended. The solicitation for consents begins today and expires June 11.
Holders must tender their debenchures in order to consent to the proposed amendments.
